title: Decide whether user continuation of a finished child replaces the parent delegation result
outcome: Consolidated Claude review session-6694, confirmed structured packet, frozen trackedHead b5d4bc4b. src/api.rs:1480 routes ordinary UI chat for completed/failed Codex children through followup_delegation_request; rearm_terminal_delegation_for_followup_locked clears result, submitted_review_result and schema version, bumps attempt and marks Running. Casual user continuation can therefore replace the parent-facing validated review with failed/unavailable if no new structured submission occurs. Decide and document whether to preserve the terminal result with detached continuation, require explicit confirmation, or restrict reviewer continuations. Include UI/parent-result regression. Related Low: new user-reopen route is Codex-only; explicitly document/reject unsupported agents or decide supported-agent scope, and keep routing in AppState. This is a policy decision/follow-up, not authorization to change the behavior. Existing tm-z0mg owns cleanup race and UI archived guard; tm-px5 owns parent-requested followup. Searched existing child/delegation/follow tasks and user-chat/user-continuation descriptions; no matching user-continuation decision found.
